description: This Java source file defines the DriverFactory class responsible for creating and managing WebDriver instances for different browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge). It contains logic for configuring browser options, handling driver setup, and ensuring stable browser sessions for automated testing environments.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: A utility class for creating, retrieving, and quitting WebDriver instances in a thread-safe manner with specific configurations for different browsers.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Returns the current WebDriver instance for the thread, throws an exception if not initialized.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Initializes a new WebDriver instance based on the configured browser type, with specific options for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge, including headless configuration and driver setup.

methods.name: resolveChromeBinaryPath
methods.description: Attempts to determine the path to the Chrome or Chromium binary from configuration or common locations.

methods.name: validateExecutable
methods.description: Checks if a given file path exists, is a file, and is executable; returns the absolute path if valid.

methods.name: isNoDisplayAvailable
methods.description: Determines if the environment has no available display based on environment variables.

methods.name: quitDriver
methods.description: Quits the current thread's WebDriver instance if it exists and cleans up the thread-local storage.
